quest.grandline.tequila_wolf_1.desc: The labourers forced to build the bridge across the sea want a night's rest from their overseers. Defeat 2 jailers.
quest.grandline.germa_kingdom_1.desc: Pirates shadow the moored fleet-kingdom, waiting for a straggler. A courtier of the fleet asks you to defeat 4 pirates.
quest.grandline.rommel_kingdom_1.desc: The keep's smith is short of metal before the snows close the harbour. Bring 6 iron ingots and drive off 3 bandits.
quest.grandline.oykot_kingdom_1.desc: A palace scholar is rebuilding the royal archive. Bring 2 books and defeat 4 bandits who raid the couriers.
quest.grandline.god_valley_1.desc: An archaeologist sifting the scorched ruins cannot work while the old guardians stalk the arena. Defeat 2 ruin guardians.
quest.grandline.kyuka_island_1.desc: Pirates keep crashing the resort's beach. The innkeeper offers a reward for 5 of them.
quest.grandline.lulusia_kingdom_1.desc: Pirates pick through the rim of the crater where a kingdom stood. The mourner at the memorial asks you to defeat 6 of them.
quest.grandline.prodence_kingdom_1.desc: The castle's fighting master tests newcomers the Prodence way: defeat 8 pirates.
quest.grandline.karai_bari_island_1.desc: The mercenary guild posts bounties on Marines. The guild bartender will pay for 3 defeated Marines (raises your bounty).
quest.grandline.mogaro_kingdom_1.desc: The royal gate's gilding is being restored. Bring 4 gold ingots and defeat 4 pirates who prey on the gate's traders.
